quiz.intro: The Beehive hosts regular quiz nights — a friendly evening at this award-winning Eaton local, for regulars and first-timers alike.
quiz.notes: Ask at the bar or check What’s On for the next date.

food.fridayPizza: Tiago’s Pizza is here every Friday, 5–9pm. Eat in or takeaway.

contact.location: The Beehive is situated on Leopold Road, around half-way between Unthank Road and Newmarket Road, and about 200m south of the ring road (at Mile End Road).
